description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

description.zh: 地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID . You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~354276~~) operation to query the most recent list of regions in which snapshot policy is supported.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ebs bind-enterprise-snapshot-policy --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-id esp-xxx --disk-targets d-xxx --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --region cn-hangzhou
